description: Twelve support tickets. Each `check` is one fact the final reply must contain; a ticket is SOLVED only if every check passes. `expect` and `reject` are regexes matched against the whole reply. Gold answers follow from fixtures/crm.json plus the Lab 2 knowledge base, with today fixed at Friday 2026-11-06 by the playbook. One ticket (`stuck: true`) cannot be answered by any model: its tracking lookup never returns data. The right outcome there is a short reply that says so and hands off to a person.

tickets.text: Order NS-48213: I opened the espresso machine and it works fine, but I've decided to return it. How much will my refund be?
Order NS-61002: I opened the blender and it works, but I want to send it back. How much will I get back?
We're account ACME-77. Your API was unreliable in October 2026. What service credit will we get, in dollars?
Account ACME-77. The card on our latest invoice was declined and the retries so far have failed too. If the last retry also fails, on what date does our account get paused?
I'm sam@brio.example and I'm locked out of my account. At what time can I try signing in again?
Order NS-70455 was placed with expedited shipping. On what date will it arrive?

checks.name: arrives November 10 (packed after cutoff, picked up Friday, two business days)

tickets.text: My return for order NS-39120 passed inspection. What is the latest date the refund will be released?

checks.name: released by November 12 (five business days after Thursday the 5th)

tickets.text: Two questions before we decide whether to close our account. After closing, how many years do you keep our invoices? And how long do you keep our support chat transcripts?

Hi, this is Dana at Acme Outfitters (account ACME-77). Three things. First, on order NS-48213 I opened the espresso machine and it works, but we want to return it: how much will the refund be? Second, your API was unreliable in October 2026: what service credit do we get, in dollars? Third, we keep getting 429 errors on our production key: what is our requests-per-minute limit, and how far over it were we at peak?

Dana from Acme again (account ACME-77, my login is dana@acme.example). Three questions. One: the card on our latest invoice was declined. If every retry also fails, on what date does the account get paused? Two: I mistyped my password a few times this morning. Am I locked out, and if not, how many more failed attempts do I have before a lockout? Three: if we close the account, how many years do you keep our invoices?

Sam at Brio Coffee here (account BRIO-12). Three things. First, order NS-61002: I opened the blender and it works, but I want to return it. How much will I get back? Second, your service was shaky in October 2026: what service credit do we get, in dollars? Third, our production key keeps hitting 429s: what is our requests-per-minute limit, and how far over it were we at peak?
Order NS-51777 still hasn't arrived. Where is the package right now?

checks.name: says tracking is unavailable and hands off to a person
